summary.text: Greg Steuerwald is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 40, assumed office in 2007, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists William Colteryahn (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Steuerwald as Gregory Steuerwald; he earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana State University in 1974 and a law degree from Indiana University Law School, Indianapolis, in 1981.

His professional experience includes working as an attorney with Steuerwald, Zielinski & Witham, a probation officer and a mediator, and he is a member of the Avon United Methodist Church, the Danville Chamber of Commerce, the Hendricks County Bar Association and the Indiana State Bar Association.
Steuerwald defeated Siddharth Mahant (R) in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary, with 75.1% of the vote.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Courts and Criminal Code, House Judiciary, and Statutory Committee on Ethics committees.
